versions.changelog:
Initial release of free-douyin-downloader.

- Download Douyin videos locally in 720p without watermark.
- Supports input via short links, share texts, or direct video URLs.
- Allows optional file name specification; defaults to video title.
- Notifies if the content is an unsupported format (e.g., notes).
- Requires only Python 3 standard library; no extra dependencies.
